references.text: The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard unit of weight for offerings, the same scale used for the silver vessels in Numbers 7:85
Describes the use of silver in the sanctuary and refers to the sanctuary shekel as the unit of weight, parallel to the weight of the silver vessels
The first time the silver basins and silver bowls are mentioned with their individual weights, which are summed up here
The introduction to the summary of all dedication gifts, where verse 85 gives details about the total weight of the silver vessels
The sanctuary shekel is defined as the standard for valuation, the same scale used for the temple silver
